package entry
import (
 f "fmt"
 env "os"
 "io"
 "log" // want depguard
 "log/slog" // want depguard
 "errors"
 "go.opentelemetry.io/otel"
 tr "go.opentelemetry.io/otel/trace"
)
func Misuse(span tr.Span) {
 _ = env.Getenv("TOKEN") // want forbidigo
 _, _ = env.LookupEnv("TOKEN") // want forbidigo
 _ = env.ExpandEnv("$TOKEN") // want forbidigo
 _ = env.Environ() // want forbidigo
 _ = env.Stdout // want forbidigo
 _ = env.Stderr // want forbidigo
 _ = env.Stdin // want forbidigo
 f.Println("debug") // want forbidigo
 f.Printf("debug") // want forbidigo
 f.Print("debug") // want forbidigo
 print("debug") // want forbidigo
 println("debug") // want forbidigo
 env.Exit(1) // want forbidigo
 _ = log.New(io.Discard, "", 0)
 _ = slog.New(slog.NewTextHandler(io.Discard, nil))
 _ = otel.GetTracerProvider() // want forbidigo
 otel.SetTracerProvider(nil) // want forbidigo
 _ = otel.Tracer("example") // want forbidigo
 otel.SetErrorHandler(nil) // want forbidigo
 otel.Handle(errors.New("failure")) // want forbidigo
 span.RecordError(errors.New("failure")) // want forbidigo
 record := span.RecordError // want forbidigo
 record(errors.New("failure"))
}
